headline: Operating profit firms up, but net income slides
summary_short: Kyndryl's fiscal Q4 revenue was $3.77B, down 2.3% q/q and 0.8% y/y, while EBITDA rose to $421M (+9.1% q/q); net income fell sharply to $17M from $57M last quarter and $69M a year ago, and cash climbed to $2.62B after a $1.0B revolving-credit draw.
summary_long: Revenue was roughly flat at $3.77B (-2.3% q/q, -0.8% y/y). Gross profit rose to $849M y/y and EBITDA to $421M (+9.1% q/q) on cost-efficiency progress, but operating income was flat q/q at $171M and net income fell sharply to $17M (from $57M q/q, $69M y/y), diluted EPS $0.08. This 10-K discusses only full fiscal-year 2026 results ($15.1B revenue, unchanged y/y; $198M net income, down $53M on lapping a prior-year $138M SIS-platform gain and a current-year arbitration reserve) — no discrete quarterly explanation is given. Cash rose to $2.62B (+94.6% q/q) after a $1.0B revolving-credit draw; long-term debt rose to $3.90B, equity fell to $1.18B on $304M of buybacks. No forward guidance was given.
